annotations.title: Kp forecast for the next 3 days

description: Answers "will there be a magnetic storm tomorrow?", "geomagnetic forecast for the next days", "when does the storm start?". NOAA's 3-day planetary K index forecast laid over today, tomorrow and the day after in the asker's time zone: each day's peak, every three-hour interval (measured once it has begun, forecast after), the next storm and a one-sentence summary. Geophysical data only; no health information.

timeZone.description: IANA time zone of the person asking, such as Europe/Moscow or America/New_York. Local times and days use it. Defaults to UTC.

name: get_kp_forecast_3day

days.description: Today and the two days after it in the requested time zone.

kpText.description: Kp as the apps write it: one decimal.

level.description: NOAA G-scale level. Kp is graded by the whole number it rounds to, so 4.67 is already G1.

peak.description: The strongest interval that begins on this day, measured or forecast; null if none does.

intervals.description: The three-hour intervals across the three local days, in time order.

issuedAt.description: When NOAA issued the forecast, UTC.
